Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 2 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 3 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 4 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 5 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 6 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import asyncio
import os
from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Optional

from google.cloud import speech_v1 as speech


async def stream_speech_to_text(
    audio_source: AsyncIterable[bytes],
    *,
    sample_rate_hertz: int,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    encoding: str = "LINEAR16",
    interim_results: bool = True,
    single_utterance: bool = False,
    max_queue_size: int = 100,
) -> AsyncIterator[dict]:
    client = speech.SpeechClient()

    recognition_config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=getattr(speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding, encoding),
        sample_rate_hertz=sample_rate_hertz,
        language_code=language_code,
    )

    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
        config=recognition_config,
        interim_results=interim_results,
        single_utterance=single_utterance,
    )

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    queue: asyncio.Queue[Optional[speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest]] = asyncio.Queue(
        maxsize=max_queue_size
    )

    async def producer() -> None:
        await queue.put(speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(streaming_config=streaming_config))
        async for chunk in audio_source:
            if chunk:
                await queue.put(speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk))
        await queue.put(None)

    def request_generator():
        while True:
            item = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(queue.get(), loop).result()
            if item is None:
                break
            yield item

    response_queue: asyncio.Queue[Optional[object]] = asyncio.Queue()

    def recognize_worker() -> None:
        try:
            responses = client.streaming_recognize(requests=request_generator())
            for response in responses:
                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(response_queue.put(response), loop).result()
        except Exception as exc:
            asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(response_queue.put(exc), loop).result()
        finally:
            asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(response_queue.put(None), loop).result()

    producer_task = asyncio.create_task(producer())
    worker_task = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(recognize_worker))

    try:
        while True:
            item = await response_queue.get()
            if item is None:
                break
            if isinstance(item, Exception):
                raise item

            response = item
            for result in response.results:
                alternative = result.alternatives[0] if result.alternatives else None
                yield {
                    "transcript": alternative.transcript if alternative else "",
                    "confidence": getattr(alternative, "confidence", 0.0) if alternative else 0.0,
                    "is_final": result.is_final,
                    "language_code": language_code,
                }
    finally:
        await producer_task
        await worker_task


async def file_chunk_source(path: str, chunk_size: int = 3200) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
    def _reader():
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            while True:
                data = f.read(chunk_size)
                if not data:
                    break
                yield data

    for chunk in await asyncio.to_thread(lambda: list(_reader())):
        yield chunk


def _ensure_google_credentials() -> None:
    if not os.getenv("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"):
        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS must be set for Google Cloud Speech-to-Text.")
